note: Assets declared dead. They stay on disk because the build scripts and the reference boards that produced them are still readable history, and because deleting an LFS object from a shared branch is a rewrite. They must never be loaded. `node tools/asset-manifest.mjs --check` fails on any reference to `path` OR `formerPath` from src/, tools/, tests/, main.cjs or index.html — the old path matters as much as the new one, because a loader that still names Assets/models/hero/v4 is exactly the mistake this move is meant to stop.
